name: Bluegrass Bash 2023

venue.name: University of Louisville, Shelby Campus/Founders Union Building

information: This competition is going to be on the second floor of the Union Founders building on the UofL Shelby campus. You can use the stairs or elevators to get up to the second floor. There will be signs and overhead monitors directing you where to go. When you arrive there will be a table set up by the entrance where you will be able to pick your group sheet.
